Synopsis:
    Maltese businessman Yorgen Fenech was acquitted of masterminding the 2017 car bomb assassination of anti-corruption journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. The article provides a timeline of the case spanning 2017–2026, covering arrests, convictions of the direct perpetrators and bomb suppliers, political fallout including the resignation of Malta's Prime Minister, and the eventual acquittal of the alleged mastermind.
